scope: All Sims supplied in the existing native household snapshot, using the same queue rows as the native policy (not selected-portrait-only); one decision per Sim per verified capture.
game_build: exact installed Sims patch identifier required; unknown/latest/any denied by native parent

queue_limit_policy.quota_policy: Never blind-fill even with apparently available capacity; reobserve after every native accepted enqueue. All returned slots are advisory, never effect permission.

identity_and_provenance.duplicate: same source-attested semantic_key across distinct queue slots; same string label alone is insufficient
identity_and_provenance.contradiction: same source-attested mutually exclusive conflict_group with different conflict_outcomes; same target alone is insufficient
identity_and_provenance.clock: ACTIVE_SIM_SECONDS, not wall clock; pause excludes timeout and invalidates preemption
identity_and_provenance.duration_samples: At most 12 independently proven same-action, same-build completed samples; sample IDs deduplicated and median actual/modeled correction clamped to [0.5,2.0]. Unknown factor means unreliable duration prediction and blocks forecast-based preemption.
identity_and_provenance.preemption: Verified critical six-needs may trigger one source-qualified running autonomous action candidate. Forecast requires two distinct calibrated completion samples, proven four modifiers, active game clock, need decay rates and 25% margin; no player queue or unproven active action.
identity_and_provenance.thrash_guard: At least 90 ACTIVE_SIM_SECONDS since last verified switch, no guessing from unknown switch history; one action proposal per tick then reobserve.
identity_and_provenance.stall: Only after calibrated estimate is exceeded by >=75% and >=30s, with a separately observed STALLED progress signal; seek reobservation rather than cancel solely on timeout.

local_acceptance: Exact version and pack source inspection of EA queue and duration hooks; compare native tuning versus script requirements
Observe actual queue size/multitasking and action identity across all household Sims; test duplicate/contradiction invalidation against same-game negative controls
Measure base and completed activity times in a consistent active simulation clock, with four genuinely attested modifiers and regression trials
5 vanilla and 5 modified disposable save trials with critical need, observed queue replacement, player takeover, paused clocks, cooldown and rollback
Never change protected saves, installed EA assets, global input/peripherals or autonomy settings; publish no private telemetry
Separate POLICY_MERGED from EA_MOD_BUILT, LOCAL_INSTALLED, LIVE_OBSERVED and GAME_CERTIFIED
